en_us.summary: Reworks a large amount of underlying behaviour: the upstream address, model list, pricing and tool ownership collapse into a single source of truth, the transport, logging and feedback are re-tuned for a resident client, the configuration, model-picking, usage-viewing and troubleshooting experience is improved, and the issues left over from earlier versions are fixed.

sections.title: Highlights
items: The upstream address now lives in Codex's config.toml as [codeseex] upstream_base_url. The settings field edits that file, the runtime resolves it on demand, a pre-0.8.0 CodeSeeX-side value migrates once, and the default official endpoint is never written.

The model list, aliases, capabilities and prices are one versioned catalog document; the published manifest carries the real DeepSeek models and official CNY prices, and an entry can be marked billing-only so it is priced without being offered.
Native Responses is the default and only implicit transport; the auto mode is gone.
The log page defaults to lifecycle and failures only, with a User/Debug control bringing the per-round diagnostics back, and transient feedback moved into a queued toast manager.

sections.title: Added
items: A toast manager: top-centre, whole row clickable to dismiss, at most three visible with the rest queued, one row per key with a counter, and an overflow summary once the queue is full.
A log detail control in Settings, Client, Other: User keeps the log to necessary messages, Debug adds the per-round bookkeeping.
Dashboard RPM and TPM over a rolling 60-second window, plus average latency.
Catalog kind (chat or billing-only) and a semantic role, so the vision model is data instead of a hard-coded slug.
Thinking-chain mirror modes — none, smart, fixed, full — that do not change what the upstream model receives.

sections.title: Changed
items: Alias and outbound slug handling is fully catalog-driven; the hard-coded GPT-5 mapping is gone.
Settings are grouped into Client, Proxy and Tools, and the web-search backend moved into its tool card.
One user turn is one usage session: native tool handoffs are marked so intermediate replies stay inside their turn.
Billing-only entries are excluded from selection, pinning and the tray; pricing resolves exact slug, then group, then an explicit unpriced state.

sections.title: Fixed
items: The embedded desktop proxy silently fell back to the official DeepSeek endpoint, so a relay key failed with 401 on every request. The environment-only config constructor is now private, the Codex-side override resolves on demand, and existing installs migrate automatically.
Image understanding follows the configured upstream, shares its credential, forwards the client identity, and takes its default model from the catalog.
Workspace scope is only trusted from Codex-injected context and never from tool output, and log summaries are redacted.

zh_cn.summary: 优化了大量底层实现：上游地址、模型清单、定价与工具归属收敛为单一数据来源，传输方式、日志与反馈按常驻客户端重新定调，并优化了配置编辑、模型选择、用量查看与故障排查体验，修复了旧版本遗留的问题。

sections.title: 重点更新
items: 上游地址改为 Codex 的 config.toml 中的 [codeseex] upstream_base_url：设置页直接编辑该文件，运行时按需解析，0.8.0 之前的旧值自动迁移一次，官方默认地址永不写入。
模型清单、别名、能力与定价收敛为一份带版本的目录文档；公开清单写入真实 DeepSeek 模型与官方人民币价格，并可标记 billing-only 条目（只计价、不提供选择）。
原生 Responses 成为默认且唯一的隐式传输方式，auto 模式移除。
日志台默认只显示生命周期与失败，新增“用户 / 调试”开关按需恢复每轮诊断；瞬时反馈改由带队列的 toast 管理器承载。

sections.title: 新增
items: toast 管理器：正上方居中、整条可点击消失、同屏最多 3 条其余排队、同 key 复用并累加计数、队列满后合并为一条摘要。
设置 → 客户端 → 其它 新增日志详细度开关。
仪表盘新增滚动 60 秒的 RPM / TPM 与平均延迟。
目录新增 kind（chat / billing_only）与语义化 role，识图模型来自数据而非写死的 slug。
思考链镜像模式（none / smart / fixed / full），不改变发给上游模型的内容。

sections.title: 变更
items: 别名与出站 slug 完全由目录驱动，删除写死的 GPT-5 映射。
设置页重组为客户端 / 代理 / 工具，网页搜索后端移入对应工具卡片。
一个用户回合对应一个用量会话：原生工具交接会被标记，中间回复留在回合内。
billing-only 条目不参与选择、上锁与托盘；定价按精确 slug → 分组 → 显式未定价解析。

sections.title: 修复
items: 桌面端内嵌代理静默回落到官方 DeepSeek 端点，导致中转 key 每次请求都 401。环境级配置构造现已私有，Codex 侧覆盖按需解析，旧值自动迁移。
图像理解跟随已配置上游、共用凭据、透传客户端身份，默认模型来自目录。
工作区范围只信任 Codex 注入的上下文，不再采信工具输出；日志摘要已脱敏。

en_us.summary: A data-driven model catalog and pricing release with an offline fallback, plus compatibility with upstreams that require a Codex client identity.

sections.title: Highlights
items: The model list, context windows, aliases, and pricing are now a versioned data document with layered sources: built-in, remote, local cache, and user overrides.
CodeSeeX can refresh the catalog from a remote manifest without shipping a new client build, re-checking it every six hours, and always keeps a complete offline fallback.
Upstream GET /models is used only as an availability probe and never as a source of windows, capabilities, or prices.
Pricing is keyed by exact model slug with an explicit group fallback and an explicit unpriced state; unknown models are never silently billed at another model's price.
Peak/off-peak billing now has a single implementation shared by the store and the UI, with window boundaries defined as [from, to).

sections.title: Fixed
items: Fixed requests to some upstream addresses being rejected for a missing Codex client identity: the client's originator, user-agent, session_id, and conversation_id are now passed through natively instead of being dropped.

Also fixed custom endpoints discarding a Codex-App-shaped payload's client Authorization in favour of a local credential. Custom endpoints now forward the client Authorization, while the official endpoint keeps credential isolation.
Added an explicit upstream credential source (auto, request, env, codex-auth, or a key stored in CodeSeeX) so changing the upstream no longer silently reuses another provider's key.
Added POST /api/upstream/test (also exposed as /manager/upstream/test), which reports the credential source, the final URL, the upstream status, and a redacted error summary.
Fixed the settings UI silently pricing unknown models as Pro.

zh_cn.summary: 模型与定价数据化更新，并兼容要求 Codex 客户端身份的上游地址。

sections.title: 重点更新
items: 模型清单、上下文窗口、别名与定价改为带版本的数据文档，并支持分层来源：内置、远程、本地缓存与用户覆盖。
可在不发新版客户端的前提下从远程清单更新模型与价格（每 6 小时自动复查），同时始终保留完整的离线保底数据。
上游 GET /models 仅作为可用性探测，不再作为窗口、能力或定价的真源。
定价按精确 slug 匹配，并提供显式分组回退与显式「未定价」状态；未知模型不再被静默套用其它模型的价格。
峰谷计费收敛为单一实现（store 与前端共用），窗口边界统一为 [起, 止)。

sections.title: 修复
items: 修复部分上游地址因缺失 Codex 客户端身份而被拒绝的问题：此前上游请求只携带 Content-Type、Accept、Authorization，客户端身份头被丢弃；现在 originator、user-agent、session_id、conversation_id 会原生透传。
同时修复自定义 endpoint 丢弃 Codex App 形态请求的客户端 Authorization、改用本地凭据的问题；现在自定义 endpoint 透传客户端 Authorization，官方 endpoint 仍保留凭据隔离。
新增显式的上游凭据来源（auto / request / env / codex-auth / CodeSeeX 内保存的 key），更换上游时不再静默沿用旧供应商标识。
新增 POST /api/upstream/test（同时支持 /manager/upstream/test），返回凭据来源、最终请求 URL、上游状态码与脱敏后的错误摘要。
修复设置页把未知模型静默按 Pro 计价的问题。

en_us.summary: The DeepSeek Responses API release with native official routing, stable context/tool continuity, dual Web Search backends, and separate image capabilities.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Official DeepSeek endpoints use the native Responses API by default for configured models.
CodeSeeX local Web Search and DeepSeek official Web Search remain separate explicit backends.
DeepSeek thinking reasoning_content is preserved across Chat compatibility follow-up turns.
Codex full replay and atomic client-tool groups remain authoritative and bounded.
Image understanding and image generation are separate tools with DeepSeek Vision support, independent credentials, and dedicated Usage phases.
Image understanding is enabled by default for new and upgraded configurations; image generation remains independent and disabled by default.
Built-in language packs share a complete key schema and use English only as the explicit fallback for untranslated newer text.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Fixed reasoning context being dropped from the 0.6.0 Chat compatibility replay path.
Fixed native tool-group settlement and bounded unterminated SSE response identity edge cases.
Fixed legacy Vision migration, default image-understanding enablement, image credential isolation, and secret-field autosave behavior.

zh_cn.summary: 面向 DeepSeek Responses API 的正式适配更新，提供官方原生路由、稳定上下文与工具续接、双 Web Search 后端和独立图像能力。

sections.title: 重点更新
items: 官方 DeepSeek endpoint 对配置模型默认使用原生 Responses API。
CodeSeeX 本地 Web Search 与 DeepSeek 官方 Web Search 继续作为两种独立后端。
Chat 兼容路径会保留 thinking 模式的 reasoning_content，支持后续请求连续回放。
Codex full replay 和客户端原子工具组继续保持权威、有界处理。
图像理解与图像生成拆为独立工具，支持 DeepSeek Vision、独立凭据和独立 Usage 阶段。
图像理解在全新安装和旧配置升级后默认开启，图像生成保持独立且默认关闭。
内置语言包使用完整键结构；尚未翻译的新文案统一显式回退英文。

sections.title: 修复
items: 修复 0.6.0 Chat 兼容回放路径丢失 reasoning 上下文的问题。
修复原生工具组结算和无终止空行 SSE response identity 的边界问题。
修复旧 Vision 配置迁移、图像理解默认启用、图像凭据隔离和密码字段 autosave 行为。

en_us.summary: A context-runtime correctness release for stable Codex replay, valid tool groups, and bounded workspace tooling.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Codex HTTP full replay is now the authoritative context instead of a proxy-managed tail continuation.
Tool-call batches and matching results stay atomic, including mixed internal and client-tool batches.
Workspace file, directory, and search tools now use bounded, paginated output for large repositories.
Added in-app release notes with version-pinned GitHub lookup and bundled offline fallback.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Fixed proxy-side replay trimming causing cache resets, oscillating context size, and lost historical context.
Fixed incomplete tool-call histories that could produce upstream tool-protocol errors.

zh_cn.summary: 一次聚焦上下文运行时正确性的更新，改进 Codex replay 连续性、工具协议完整性和 workspace 工具边界。

sections.title: 重点更新
items: Codex HTTP full replay 现在作为权威上下文处理，不再使用代理管理的尾部 continuation。
工具调用批次和对应结果保持原子完整，包括内部工具与客户端工具混合批次。
workspace 文件、目录和搜索工具现在为大型仓库提供有界、可分页的输出。
新增应用内更新日志，支持按版本读取 GitHub 内容和内置离线回退。

sections.title: 修复
items: 修复代理侧 replay 裁剪导致的缓存重置、上下文使用率跳动和历史上下文丢失。
修复不完整工具调用历史可能触发上游工具协议错误的问题。

en_us.summary: A focused agent-stability hotfix for client tool recovery and upstream diagnostics.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Repeated client tool failures now remain visible to the model instead of becoming terminal proxy errors by default.
Follow-up requests such as "continue" no longer inherit a stale client tool handoff stop.
Upstream response decode failures now include safer diagnostics for network, proxy, and upstream troubleshooting.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Fixed legitimate troubleshooting workflows being interrupted after several failing shell command handoffs.
Fixed repeated patch or shell failures being able to affect later continuation requests.

zh_cn.summary: 一次聚焦 Agent 稳定性的热修复，改进客户端工具恢复与上游诊断。

sections.title: 重点更新
items: 重复客户端工具失败默认继续回填给模型处理，不再直接变成代理层终止错误。
“请继续”等后续请求不再继承旧的客户端工具 handoff 停止状态。
上游响应体解码失败现在会记录更安全的网络、代理与上游诊断信息。

sections.title: 修复
items: 修复正常排障流程中多个 shell_command 失败后被过早中断的问题。
修复重复 apply_patch 或 shell 失败可能影响后续继续请求的问题。

en_us.summary: Release-readiness and desktop updater stability improvements.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Added in-app update checks, download progress, cancellation, and passive installation on supported desktop builds.
Added Codex runtime catalog diagnostics and safer experimental Codex App model-list integration.
Improved full-context replay handling around Codex App model switches.

zh_cn.summary: 发布准备与桌面更新稳定性改进。

sections.title: 重点更新
items: 新增应用内检查更新、下载进度、取消下载和受支持桌面包的被动安装。
新增 Codex runtime catalog 诊断，并加固实验性 Codex App 模型列表集成。
改进 Codex App 切换模型时的 full-context replay 处理。

en_us.summary: A stability and billing-display update for long-running agent tasks.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Added DeepSeek peak and off-peak billing estimates, enabled by default.
Improved Vision tool configuration layout and scoped right-click Select all to the active page or input.
Improved usage billing buckets by model and billing period.

zh_cn.summary: 面向长时间 Agent 任务的稳定性与计费显示更新。

sections.title: 重点更新
items: 新增并默认开启 DeepSeek 峰谷计费估算。
优化识图工具配置布局，并将右键全选限制在当前页面或输入框。
按模型和计费时段拆分用量计费桶。

en_us.summary: A stability and experience update for the Rust and Tauri desktop line.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Refined Usage, Logs, settings, screenshots, and release-facing desktop UI.
Added optional DeepSeek Flash and Pro selection in Codex App while keeping CodeSeeX-side switching as the recommended path.
Improved Web Search probing, evidence opening, fallback behavior, and diagnostics.

zh_cn.summary: Rust 与 Tauri 桌面版本线的一次稳定性和体验更新。

sections.title: 重点更新
items: 优化 Usage、Logs、设置、截图和发布相关的桌面 UI。
可选在 Codex App 中选择 DeepSeek Flash / Pro，仍建议优先从 CodeSeeX 内切换。
优化 Web Search 的源探针、证据打开、fallback 行为和诊断。
